label: baseline
description: Two-activity walk of the delivery-cost fixture corpus, one activity at each end of the size scale against a meta namespace derived from core-ops.ts (tests/token-bench-corpus.ts, built by --fixture-corpus). Engine CI gates delivery against this; a work-package character-count belongs on the corpus tree under walks/. `activityDeliveries` splits each delivery into the role contract and the body that varies with the activity, so a change that moves one share is not mistaken for one that moves the other.
